props.gloss_en: one may not slaughter [so that the blood flows] into seas, into rivers, or into vessels
but one may slaughter into a pool of water
and on a ship, [one may slaughter] onto vessels
one may not slaughter into a hole at all
but one may make a hole inside his house so that the blood will enter it
and in the marketplace he may not do so
so that he will not emulate the heretics
why not into seas? because they will say: he is slaughtering to the angel of the sea
Rava: they taught it [the pool permission] of murky water

objections.gloss_en: לתוך עוגה של מים נמי אמרי: לבבואה קא שחיט! -- into a pool too they will say: he slaughters to his reflection

answered_by.gloss_en: בעכורים שנו -- they taught it of murky water (= p_okimta_achurim); 'which shows no reflection' is Steinsaltz's explanation
